result.brief: 该工作形式化时序世界模型的动作条件预测，提出机制一致性指标与方向性监督损失，并构建跨八个真实数据集的基准，揭示预测精度与机制一致性之间的分歧。
result.reason: Formalizes time series world models with action-conditioned prediction, mechanism consistency metric, and directional supervision; directly addresses world-model action response and planning evaluation.
